parameters.query: SELECT j.job_id, j.job_type, j.entity_id, j.correlation_id, j.payload, j.attempt, ch.id AS channel_id, ch.name AS channel_name, ch.platforms, ch.clip_min_seconds, ch.clip_max_seconds, ch.rules, ch.timezone, ch.quality_threshold, n.name AS niche_name, n.keywords FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = NULLIF(j.payload->>'channel_id','')::uuid LEFT JOIN niches n ON n.id = ch.niche_id WHERE j.job_id = $1::uuid AND j.status = 'running'

SELECT s.source_id, s.title, s.creator, s.source_platform, ch.platforms, (SELECT to_jsonb(p) FROM permissions p WHERE p.source_id = s.source_id AND p.status = 'active' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS permission, ca_setting('policy_source_urls', '{}'::jsonb) AS policy_urls, (CASE WHEN $3::boolean THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(platform, summary), '{}'::jsonb) FROM policy_knowledge WHERE expires_at > now()) END) AS cached FROM sources s JOIN channels ch ON ch.id = $2::uuid WHERE s.source_id = $1::uuid

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Load Job').first().json.job_id, 'RESOURCE', 'no enabled model provider is available (quota/circuit/config)'] }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: $json.body.system }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.body.prompt }] }], generationConfig: { responseMimeType: 'application/json', temperature: 0.4 } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, temperature: 0.4, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.body.system }, { role: 'user', content: $json.body.prompt }] }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $json.model, stream: false, format: 'json', options: { temperature: 0.4, num_ctx: 8192 }, messages: [{ role: 'system', content: $json.body.system }, { role: 'user', content: $json.body.prompt }] }) }}

parameters.query: SELECT ca_model_result($1, false, $2) AS state, $2::text AS err
